props.gloss_en: Rabba bar Rav Huna: any person who has Torah but no fear of Heaven is like a treasurer to whom they gave the inner keys but not the outer keys -- by what will he enter?
R' Yannai would proclaim: woe to one who has no courtyard and makes a gate for the courtyard
Rav Yehuda: the Holy One created His world only so that they would fear before Him
Rav Yehuda: as it is said 'and God has made it so that they should fear before Him' (Eccl 3:14)
one [of R' Simon and R' Elazar]: let us rise before him [R' Yaakov bar Acha], for he is a man who fears sin
the other: let us rise before him, for he is a man of Torah
the first, to the other: I tell you he is a man who fears sin, and you tell me he is a man of Torah?!
conclude that it is R' Elazar who said 'he is a man who fears sin'
R' Elazar: the Holy One has in His world only fear of Heaven alone
R' Elazar: as it is said 'and now, Israel, what does the Lord your God ask of you but to fear...' (Deut 10:12)
R' Elazar: and it is written 'and He said to man: behold [hen], the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom' (Job 28:28)
R' Elazar: for in the Greek language they call 'one' hen
